title: Audit where each global CLAUDE.md section matters, before any section moves
why: The global CLAUDE.md loads in every turn of every repo (3,890 words), but many sections matter only in some repos or roles.
note: R35 (owner 12:38 and 12:40 CST Nov 11, relayed by the retrospective; plan 6f94a10). Owner 12:38: "im wondering whether i properly keep claude.md's just at the repo level and claude-settings level as its parent and no where further"; 12:40: "yes that's fine it would need my sign off (the actual results of the review) but just marking it as an item for review is good to do now". Steps: (1) a read-only audit maps each global CLAUDE.md section to the repos and roles where it matters; (2) the owner signs off the results before any section moves; (3) a lane moves sections to path-scoped rules or skills, and lint/check_claude_md_size.py counts words too (today it counts lines: 108 of 200).
